title: Technical Design Lead for Salesforce Field Service Management
description:
Founded in 1910, KONE is a global leader that provides elevators, escalators and automatic building doors, as well as solutions for maintenance and modernization that add value to buildings throughout their life cycle. Our mission is to improve the flow of urban life and make our world’s cities better places to live by providing innovative solutions that help make people’s journeys safe, convenient and reliable. Our operations in over 60 countries around the world has helped us achieve our position as an innovation and sustainability leader with repeated recognitions by Forbes , Corporate Knights for clean capitalism and others.


KONE’s vision is to create the Best People Flow experience by providing ease, effectiveness and experience to our customers and users. In line with our strategy, Sustainable Success with Customers, we will focus on increasing the value we create for customers with new intelligent solutions and embed sustainability even deeper across all of our operations. By closer collaboration with customers and partners, KONE will increase the speed of bringing new services and solutions to the market.


**KONE Technology and Innovation Unit (KTI)** is where we combine the physical world – escalators and elevators – with smart and connected digital systems. We are changing and improving the way billions of people move within buildings every day. We are on a mission to expand and develop new digital solutions that are based on emerging technologies.


**KONE IT** is a global team of expert professionals working along with business functions and area teams to develop new capabilities and enable new business opportunities. We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud\-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption. Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation are at the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part of KONE’s success.

  

You will own the architecture, technical design, configuration, development and design related to our Field Service Management solution (FSM). KONE was the first company in the world to partner with Salesforce on the Field Service Management, and through that co\-creation FSM entity is built on top of Salesforce Field Service Lightning solution, combined with custom built mobile experience for tens of thousands of field technicians.


As the Technical Design Lead you will lead and guide internal and external teams in developing and implementing FSM. You are responsible for establishing guidelines and processes, as well as validating and approving all designs. You will work closely also with Product Owners and Enterprise Architects to drive solution architecture, enabling high performance, maintainability, scalability and security.


Main Responsibilities


* Own the technical design and solution both for FSM Core and FSM Mobile
* Own the solution functionality design as per approved demands, and translate those to IT functional and technical requirements
* Defines the optimal configuration with maximal utilization of out\-of\-the\-box functionality vs KONE\-specific customization
* Support in defining data model and controlling data integrity for the solutions
* Support application support teams and KONE service management in problem management
* Support FSM license management
* Ensure that solution development is in line with business objectives, user needs, target architecture and IT standards \& frameworks
* Ensure the solution documentation is always up\-to\-date
* Understand the FSM solution big\-picture and the target state and it’s role in IT landscape and service business processes.

The desired candidate will have


* M.Sc. degree or equivalent
* Professional experience of minimum 12 years in IT industry, with at least 8 years in Salesforce
* Expertise and hands on experience in Salesforce Field Service Lightning and Service Cloud products and their implementation
* Expertise and hands on experience in custom mobile architectures
* Good knowledge of handling \& simplifying Salesforce data integration designs with backend systems like SAP, IoT etc.
* Salesforce App Builder and Developer certification(s). Other Salesforce certification(s) are an added advantage
* Demonstrated track record of clear achievements from previous positions held
* Experience in leadership and matrix organizations
* Experience with supplier collaboration / collaboration with development partners
* Experience in working in international environment with stakeholders distributed globally
* Excellent stakeholders’ communication skills (both written and oral)
* Excellent change management, analysis and problem solving skills
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills in English

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co\-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

Read more on *https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html*

title: Business Analysis, SWIFT, SEPA, ISO 20022 / Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist


In this role, you will:

* Own and produce end\-to\-end solution designs for new features, market onboardings, and platform changes. Define integration patterns between RTP microservices, scheme adapters, and external systems
* Translate business and scheme requirements into detailed User story specifications consumable by engineering teams. Validate proposed solutions against NFR targets and platform constraints before build commences
* Act as the techno\-functional bridge between Product, Business, and Engineering. Participate in scheme interpretation workshops — translating regulatory and scheme rule changes into platform impact assessments
* Support Architects and product owners in refining requirements to the level required for engineering consumption. Conduct functional impact assessments for change requests — identifying affected services, data flows, and downstream dependencies
* Review solution artefacts produced by other team members for correctness, completeness, and alignment to architecture standards. Participate in design reviews and architecture forums. Ensure designs comply with HSBC technology standards, security policies, and data governance requirements
* Contribute to test scenario definition — ensuring functional and non\-functional test coverage reflects the solution design. Engage with MT leads, architects, internal interface teams and external scheme operators to clarify requirements and validate solutions
* Support sprint planning and backlog refinement by breaking down epics into well\-defined, estimable user stories. Provide functional expertise during UAT and SIT — supporting defect triage and resolution from a business logic perspective
* Assist with market go\-live readiness — solution validation, operational handover, and runbook documentation


To be successful, you will:

* Real\-Time Payment Schemes \- Deep understanding of RTP/IP scheme rules, clearing, settlement, and scheme connectivity (e.g., SWIFT, SEPA Inst, FPS, UAEFTS, STC Pay equivalent schemes)
* ISO 20022 Messaging \- Ability to interpret, map, and design around pacs.008, pacs.002, camt messages — understanding field\-level semantics
* Payment Lifecycle \- End\-to\-end understanding — origination, routing, validation, processing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception handling
* Scheme Compliance \& Rules \- Awareness of scheme mandates, cutover timelines, format validations, and compliance obligations
* Market Onboarding \- Experience supporting or leading new market / corridor onboarding from a functional and solution perspective
* Microservices Architecture \- Ability to design service boundaries, define APIs, and produce High level solution design
* Data Flow \& Sequencing \- Able to produce and validate sequence diagrams, data flow diagrams, and interaction models across services
* Integration Patterns \- Experience with synchronous and asynchronous integration, retry strategies, fallback pattern, Non\-Functional Requirements \- Ability to define and validate NFRs — latency, throughput, availability, scalability, and resilience targets

  

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.


www.hsbc.com/careers  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”


Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Digital S/W Engineer Analyst SDE \- Mobile Development is a Technology/ Engineering role involving both development and Testing. As a member of the SCRUM team, you will be
  

delivering Customer facing Banking and/or Credit Card features on digital channels such as Browser and Mobile. You will be involved in all stages of the Agile SDLC cycle. It includes but not
  

limited to (a) Requirement analysis: Grooming of user stories, Story pointing, decomposing big stories into smaller stories and define acceptance criteria. (b) Design Review: Reviewing
  

screens, flows, features, and customer communications (emails, SMS’s, notifications, PDF documents) and making sure that they are consistent with user story acceptance criteria
  

(c) Software development: Developing, configuring and debugging applications comprising of mobile frontend and Micro services. (d) Validations: Creating automated and manual test scripts
  

on BDD (Behavior Based Development) framework, executing test scripts. Identifying, triaging and fixing any defects. Conditioning and maintaining the test data. (e) Artifact
  

Ownership: Creating and maintaining testing artifacts such as Test plans and Exit reports and maintaining traceability as per SDLC guidelines. Maintaining SDLC hygiene involving stories.
  

Test cases and defects. Ensuring that no untested code goes out to production. (f) SDLC Process and Standards: Adhering to ADA (Americans with Disability Act) Guidelines, participating in
  

retrospectives, process improvement workshops, audits and performing root cause analysis. (g) Postproduction support: Supporting the technical check outs during release go live and
  

postproduction activities.


Responsibilities


* Translate application designs into code across Android/Jetpack/Kotlin development platforms as Primary Skill, with guidance from senior developers.
* Deep understanding of the **Android SDK**, platform lifecycle, and Google ecosystem (Jetpack, Android Runtime, etc.)
* Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to assist with code generation, refactoring, and debugging tasks.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of BDD (Behavior Driven Development) automated and manual test scripts in a code repository; execute scripts and record results in a test management tool.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to help accelerate unit test creation, API scaffolding, Angular components, and Spring Boot boilerplate code.
* Participate in the software development lifecycle including development, integration, and E2E testing within a CI/CD environment (e.g., RTC, Jenkins).
* Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code under the guidance of senior engineers, and take accountability for assigned features.
* Build and maintain documentation for your features and begin developing subject matter expertise in specific areas of the application.
* Assist in analyzing root causes for application issues and performance concerns; collaborate within the scrum team to triage and report defects.
* Learn and adhere to SDLC control processes and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.
* Perform functional validations to meet acceptance criteria; gain familiarity with Responsive Web Design validation and ADA Accessibility testing tools (e.g., NVDA, Voiceover, Talkback, Axe).
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to tracking progress against team objectives.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced environment involving onshore and offshore teams.

Education, Qualification \& Certifications


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or a related STEM field, or comparable work experience.
* 4\- 7 years of experience in full\-stack mobile development and/or testing in a professional environment.
* Basic familiarity with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) concepts; exposure to test automation frameworks such as Selenium with Cucumber is a plus.
* Exposure to or interest in cloud\-based development platforms such as OpenShift is desirable but not required.
* Basic working knowledge of collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Eagerness to learn, self\-motivated, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Good written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team.
